title: FOCUS ON The Common GOOD: GROUP DISTRIBUTIONAL ROBUSTNESS FOLLOWS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group accuracy on the CelebA dataset, grouping image classification examples by the subject's gender to identify performance disparities on minority groups (e.g., male blondes vs. female blondes).
Evaluating worst-group accuracy on the CivilComments-WILDS toxicity classification dataset, utilizing demographic annotations like 'white' and 'black' to measure subpopulation performance drops.
Evaluating worst-group accuracy on the CivilComments-WILDS toxicity classification dataset using demographic annotations such as 'muslim' to measure specific group performance drops.
Evaluating worst-group accuracy on the CivilComments-WILDS toxicity classification dataset utilizing demographic annotations like 'gay' to measure disparate subpopulation performance.

Evaluating worst-region Pearson correlation and out-of-domain accuracy on the PovertyMap-WILDS and FMoW-WILDS datasets, assessing disparities across different wealth indices, urban/rural settlements, and geographical countries/regions.
